title: Depth circuit structure
statement: A depth circuit on $n$ Boolean coordinates consists of a gate type shared by all gates in the first layer, a list of first-layer gates each specified by a term on those coordinates, and a circuit tail whose number of available inputs is the number of gates in the first layer.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit is on $n$ Boolean coordinates
The first-layer gates share one gate type
The first layer is a list of terms on the $n$ coordinates
The tail has as many available inputs as there are first-layer gates
